workflow:
apiVersion: contractor/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: openapi-prepare-work
  version: '1'
spec:
  parameters:
    checking_workflow:
      required: true
    selection:
      required: true
    max_items:
      required: true
    scanner:
      required: false
    server:
      required: false
    operations:
      required: false
    test_parameters:
      required: false
    credential_id:
      required: false
  inputs:
    openapi:
      required: true
      mediaTypes:
      - application/json
      - application/yaml
      - application/zip
    request_values:
      required: false
      mediaTypes:
      - application/json
  outputs:
    work:
      required: true
      primary: true
      mediaTypes:
      - application/json
  entryStage: prepare
  stages:
    prepare:
      objective: Prepare bounded independently selectable OpenAPI operation work
      operation:
        ref: openapi-prepare-work@1
        arguments:
          workflow:
            source: parameter
            name: checking_workflow
          selection:
            source: parameter
            name: selection
          max_items:
            source: parameter
            name: max_items
          scanner:
            source: parameter
            name: scanner
            default: ''
          server:
            source: parameter
            name: server
            default: ''
          operations:
            source: parameter
            name: operations
            default: ''
          test_parameters:
            source: parameter
            name: test_parameters
            default: ''
          credential_id:
            source: parameter
            name: credential_id
            default: ''
      context:
        artifacts:
          openapi:
            namespace: inputs
            name: openapi
            required: true
          request_values:
            namespace: inputs
            name: request_values
            required: false
      result:
        artifacts:
          work:
            required: true
            mediaTypes:
            - application/json
            from:
              namespace: prepared-work
              name: work
      workflowOutputs:
        work: work
      'on':
        succeeded:
          succeed: {}
        failed:
          fail: {}
        interrupted:
          fail: {}
